**Average (median) house price in California (2024)**  
- **Median home value:** ≈ $800 000 USD  
- **Average (mean) home value:** ≈ $850 000 USD  

> *Sources:* Zillow Home Value Index (ZVI), 2024; California Association of Realtors (CAR) market reports.  

> **Note:**  
> • “Median” is the most commonly cited figure for California housing prices and is often used interchangeably with “average” in public discussions.  
> • The mean (average) price is slightly higher because a few very expensive properties pull the average up.  
> • Prices vary widely across the state: San Francisco Bay Area and Los Angeles County are well above the state average, while rural counties are below.  

If you need a more precise figure for a specific county or city, let me know!
